schema.changes_from_version_1: extended from two to three architectures; per-architecture entries are now seed_summary dictionaries (n, mean, sd, min, max, range, cv, per_seed) instead of mean/sd/per_seed

removed_keys.effect_width_vs_baseline: replaced by '<metric>.pairwise_differences', keyed 'wider - narrower'; the '2×512 - 2×256' entry holds the former values unchanged

sd_definition: sample SD, ddof=1, across training seeds (final_within_seed_episode_sd is the population SD, ddof=0, across the 10 final-evaluation episodes of one run)
pairwise_note: difference = wider minus narrower architecture; unpaired (the same numeric seed in two architectures is not a matched sample); exact permutation p has minimum 0.10 for 3 vs 3 and is exploratory only

eval_drops.definition: fall of more than 1,000 in mean periodic return versus the previous evaluation; diagnostics are the max over the preceding 25,000 training steps divided by that run's median
eval_drops.spearman_note: Exploratory and descriptive only: runs and consecutive evaluation intervals are pooled although they are temporally dependent (autocorrelated, overlapping training windows), so the effective sample size is far below the number of intervals and no p-value is attached; the early-training phase confounds the all-interval coefficients (see the after-250k columns). A rank correlation is not evidence of causation.
